title: Knowledge Recall Schema V1
description: Canonical schema for Knowledge Recall — the input/output contract for querying the Knowledge-Memory Authority system.

layers.description: Optional memory layer filter. Omit to search all layers.

top_k.description: Maximum number of results to return.

mission_id.description: Optional mission scope. When provided, only results within this mission are returned.

include_candidates.description: Whether to include candidate (uncommitted) memory records in results.

include_superseded.description: Whether to include superseded records in results.

trace_id.description: Distributed trace identifier for this recall request.
